defs.meaning: 更出色的；更好的；更健康的；更优质的；更纤细的；更锋利的

examples.en: I understood in general what she was talking about, but some of the finer details were beyond me.
examples.zh: 我大致知道她在说什么，但是一些更具体的细节没弄明白。

examples.en: The force of collision spewed large amounts of debris into the atmosphere, darkening the skies for several years before the finer particles settled.
examples.zh: 碰撞的力量将大量碎片喷射到大气中，在更细的粒子落下之前，天空会变暗几年。

examples.en: I relied on an appeal to his finer feelings.
examples.zh: 我寄望能打动他的爱心。
